data.standardized_narrative: Unable to reliably extract gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2017 or a definitive gross prior-year reserve movement from the supplied images. The report images are low-resolution / rotated and many balance sheet and note figures are not legible. A claims development table is present but could not be parsed robustly; narrative references to prior-year movements are either net of reinsurance or unclear. Accordingly the direction is marked 'mixed' pending access to a higher-quality source.
data.data_quality_notes: Document provided as low-resolution rotated images. Key numeric lines (gross 'Claims outstanding' at 1 January 2017, and the 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross column) are not legible with confidence. A gross claims development table appears on page 31 but individual cells could not be parsed reliably from the images. Many P&L and note figures visible are net of reinsurance or are P&L 'claims incurred' rows (which are explicitly NOT prior-year reserve movements). I therefore return nulls for critical quantitative fields rather than risk incorrect extraction. Higher-quality, upright PDF or higher-resolution images of the Balance Sheet (Liabilities - Technical provisions: Claims outstanding) and the specific note titled 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' or the claims development (gross) triangle would allow full extraction.
